name: bodhi-distro
description: Bodhi seed: a first conversation and working habits for Player One, the human founding a Bodhi instance. A practice, not an app.

plugins.name: bodhi
plugins.description: The Bodhi seed skill: a first hello, then writing, planning, research and creative work with Player One. Keeps exact words, checks claims against sources, and suggests tools only when a task calls for them.

plugins.name: bodhi-orchestrator
plugins.description: Optional Bodhi skill: route each part of a job to the cheapest lane that does it well (premium, local, vision, or human review), and spend the expensive model on judgment.

plugins.name: bodhi-grill
plugins.description: Optional Bodhi skill: stress-test a plan one question at a time, each with a recommended answer, until every branch is settled.

plugins.name: bodhi-nap
plugins.description: Optional Bodhi skill: a catch-up consolidation pass when a scheduled review did not run. Extracts sourced findings for review and never writes to accepted notes.

plugins.name: bodhi-synthesis
plugins.description: Optional Bodhi skill: a review gate that turns one queued lead into one entry with its source verified.
